identification: Qihoo 360 security uninstaller infected with a native PE/VBA hybrid file infector
family_limit: AV names Expiro/Lodbak are leads. The family and downstream operator are not independently established.
marker_note: Qihoo uninstaller: injected decoder runs PE/VBA virus; rules fixed
reason: A patched CRT startup call runs a scattered arithmetic decoder, activates concealed native code, and manually maps disguised DLLs carrying OOXML macro infection code. These alterations have no uninstall purpose.
deployment_limit: Original delivery, invoker and authorization are absent. The uninstaller host itself has normal security-product cleanup capabilities; those are not treated as proof of malicious intent.
reverse_engineering: PE32 GUI, version resource claims 360 security setup 12.0.0.1621; original filename Setup.exe and PDB UninstallRelease/uninst.pdb. Checksum and certificate layout are inconsistent with content; neither alone supplies the verdict.
Entry VA 0x491b8e calls 0x4148a2 before the normal CRT path at 0x491a11. The injected call reaches code fragments at 0x414949 onward, interleaved with original functions.

The saved return address plus 0xa3a0d selects the host VirtualAlloc IAT slot. The decoder calls VirtualAlloc(NULL,0x18d4a9,0x3000,0x40), then uses the return address plus 0x13cb59 to read the appended body at VA 0x551400.

Jump-separated byte/word/dword additions and subtractions decode 0x24 bytes per loop, ending at 0xbe008 bytes. VA 0x421952 recovers the buffer base; 0x421dd3 adds 0x61ca6 and CALL ECX enters the decoder output. The independent Unicorn reconstruction stops BEFORE this transfer.

The decoded header supplies two payload offsets/lengths and separate x86/x64 loader entries. The x86 bootstrap 0x61ca6 calls 0x5f0e6, whose PEB/export walk hashes names by rotating 19 bits and adding bytes.

The loader XORs embedded data with the 32-byte header key and uses RtlDecompressBuffer with LZNT1. Independent decompression produces 528896-byte x86 and 514560-byte x64 images with PNG magic and an alternate NT-header pointer at byte 8.

The custom image mapper at stage offset 0x612f6 accepts both normal MZ/PE and PNG-shaped headers, allocates an image, copies sections, fixes relocations/imports and invokes initialization. The PNG branch obtains a relocation/name seed from the checksum field. Import names use a seeded MSVC-LCG XOR stream; relocated absolute operands are XOR-masked with the seed.

The x86 bootstrap enumerates exports and calls _a@4 (name assembled at 0x61ebb); x64 exports a. The repaired x86 export at VA 0x100035fb initializes state and calls CreateThread at 0x100036d1 with a worker at 0x10003461.

The recovered native code refers to word/vbaProject.bin at 0x1001fdb7 and passes it to an archive writer at 0x1001fdc1. The OOXML rewrite at 0x100212f9..0x10021346 replaces the normal document content type with macroEnabled and adds VBA/CustomXML parts. A customUI onLoad template activates generated VBA.

The embedded VBA iterates document CustomXMLParts, decodes Base64 with MSXML nodeTypedValue, allocates memory, copies Data(0), changes memory to executable/read, and starts a thread at that buffer. Names containing %fn%, %vn% and %slf% are generation placeholders, not fixed campaign indicators.

reproducibility.method: Only arithmetic decoding is emulated; API hooks cannot perform Windows file, network or process actions. Decompression and reconstruction are independent Python operations.

rule_changes.change: Add a bounded jump-linked arithmetic decoder/handoff YARA variant; retain the previous contiguous decoder unchanged and accept either in the resource execution composite. Existing code-cave infection composite now fires.
rule_changes.scope: No filenames, keys, exact payload sizes or addresses are required.

rule_changes.change: Detect the recovered CustomXML native-thread VBA template and compose it with existing macro-enabled OOXML/VBA-part facts to describe an embedded infection kit.
rule_changes.limitation: The encrypted outer file does not directly expose these strings.

rule_changes.change: Replace the mining-directory InitEngine substring rule with a neutral DLL-entrypoint command-template rule in process/create/construction. Update its resource stager consumer.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: The queue file has only the standalone function name, not a rundll dispatch format or evidence of mining.
rule_changes.retained_positive: The original 9bc6539e... sample contains %s "%s",InitEngine %s; both the corrected primitive and original resource-WinExec hostile consumer match.

rule_changes.change: Move PhysicalDrive0 text to fs/path/device/storage; keep the matcher/scope/severity and the destructive-sector-write consumer.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: A raw device-name reference does not establish embedded C# or an MBR wipe.

rule_changes.change: Move generic PHP collect/beacon paths and their reporting/gateway selector to http/url/php-endpoint. Keep supported endpoint observations; collect-path suspicion becomes notable, beacon-path observation becomes notable.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: A PHP path does not establish a malicious domain, C2, collection, contact or exfiltration. The queue URL is https://open.soft.360.cn/report.php.
rule_changes.retained_positive: Existing php-exfil.exe still has its hostile browser-stealer chain; php-log-only.exe has no high finding.

rule_changes.change: Add an explicit AMD64 PE-machine fact to the x64 thread API composite.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: This engine emitted the x64 wrapper on the i386 uninstaller despite its arch scope; ordinary CreateThread remains detected. The repaired x64 DLL still matches.

rule_changes.change: Preserve the relevant CrystalX parent-directory exclusion references explicitly when moving observations. The InitEngine exclusion now requires the actual dispatch template.
rule_changes.consumer_audit: Exact old IDs plus every ancestor selector were searched; CrystalX is the only broad objectives/impact and objectives/command-and-control consumer relevant to these moves.

rule_changes.change: Describe the existing suspicious resource/relocation finding as a relocation overhang; remove unsupported wording that the static metadata alone proves hiding.

additional_checks.amd64_thread_api_positive: MATCHED on reconstructed x64 DLL; i386 queue file NOT MATCHED.
additional_checks.initengine_stager_positive: 2 matched, 0 not matched on fetched original creation-positive.
additional_checks.fetch_provenance: Additional originals and .forage.json records remain in scratch; recovered SHA-256 identities were checked.

material_detection_losses: No supported hostile coverage was lost. Wrong mining/rundll, C#-wipe, C2-directory and x64-wrapper claims were corrected. Several unchanged neutral OR aliases/baseline observations disappear from the rendered report through engine filtering; test-rules confirms registry-value-write and PHP reporting still match and their primitives remain. Old decoder and actual destructive-wipe hostile positives are retained.
archive_members: The queue file is one PE and has no automatically expanded members in before/after reports. Manually reconstructed native stages were analyzed separately; the wiper regression also retains its hostile main.pyc archive-member detection.
remaining_gaps: The outer file has two hostile traits, below the 3-5 goal. The distinct Word/OOXML infection behavior is detected on the reconstructed DLL but remains XOR/LZNT1 concealed in the outer specimen. The static engine does not replay this custom arithmetic decoder and recurse into its output. No extra family or behavior rule was invented to raise the outer count.

Combined atomscan output changes from level -1/confidence 0 to level 25/confidence 92, probability 0.99. Standalone model route class fields remain 0 (raw main probability 0.95693666 to 0.9801708); the hostile rules close the practical verdict gap. The installed feature model is v18 while the scanner expects v21.

No live payload execution or successful C2 connection was observed. WinHTTP, network-share and token APIs in the decoded DLL do not by themselves establish communication, lateral movement or privilege escalation, so no such hostile claim was added.
